hard_rules: Use master artwork unchanged in engine migration proof of concept.
Do not regenerate, redesign, swap hairstyle, scarf, coat, body proportions or face.
All new animation frames must be derived from and visually matched to the approved master.
Use separate scene lighting; do not bake flashlight/streetlight direction into the character.
Never replace the master without explicit user approval.
test_policy: During engine migration test, reuse exact existing sprite and keep legacy v6 playable. Prioritize collision/occlusion/controls over replacement character art.
